title: Multi-Attribute Duplicate Prevention Protocol
procedure: 1. Normalize company name: strip legal entities, lowercase, remove punctuation.
2. Normalize designation: stem core role keywords.
3. Extract start_year and end_year using extract_years_from_tenure().
4. Evaluate 3-way match: match_company AND match_designation AND match_years.
5. If Company and Designation match but Years differ, flag as SEPARATE_STINT and allow insertion.
